claims.text: The four conditions of POL-NS-01 must all hold for a no-show fee, and limb (c) does not: the driver's qualifying in-geofence dwell is 195 seconds — 21 consecutive fixes from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35 — against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a shortfall of 105 seconds. POL-NS-02 confirms the arrival proximity test is met and directs that the dispute then turns on dwell under POL-NS-01(c). The dwell fails, and under POL-NS-06 the $4.00 fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full — the same five minutes the app itself told the rider to wait.

The charge also fails on the trip record alone, without reaching the trace at all: the driver's own 'arrived' marker is 19:41:35 and he terminated the trip at 19:44:40, only 185 seconds later. Even taking the platform's own arrival event and its own clock at face value, the 300-second STANDARD waiting period had not elapsed when he cancelled, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails and POL-NS-06 requires a full refund of the cancellation fee.

No accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) can bridge that shortfall. The trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for limb (i) to add to the first, and the only traffic advisory on file, EV-ADVIS-00203-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — no advisory records a no-stopping restriction, enforcement operation or closure at Blk 267 Tampines St 21 in this window. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable, as the derived block states, the advisory cannot reduce the required minimum, and the 105-second shortfall stands as a full refund.

The rider was not a no-show in fact. The rider track in the same 100%-coverage trace carries 60 fixes, every one of them inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius that POL-NS-04(c) sets — the farthest 51.6 m from the pin, the mean 42.8 m. The rider's own device was at the pickup, within the radius, throughout the waiting window the driver was required to serve; a rider who is at the pin is not a rider who failed to show.

The chat log shows the driver had notice the rider was on his way and cancelled anyway: the rider wrote at 19:42:50, the driver read the message at 19:43:02, and the driver cancelled the trip 110 seconds later at 19:44:40 — about 100 seconds before the 300-second waiting period would have run out at 19:46:20 on the trace clock. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00203 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY: 'wait ah, i coming liao' is code-switched Singlish and genuinely contestable between 'on my way' and 'already here'. I therefore rest nothing on how the words are read; the send, delivery, read and cancellation timestamps are unambiguous, and the refund under POL-NS-06 does not depend on the chat at all.

No driver compensation is payable on this trip. POL-NS-07 compensates the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; it is not, and POL-NS-06 provides in terms that where cumulative dwell falls short of the minimum 'the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable'. The $3.20 driver-compensation figure computed in the fare breakdown is not earned on a 195-second hold, and the rider must not fund it.

Nothing in evidence integrity pushes this case to escalation or caps the outcome at a partial refund. The deciding fact — the 195-second dwell — rests on EV-GPS-00203, an unbroken 10-second trace with 100% coverage, no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0) and the rider track present, at weight 1.0, and on EV-TRIP-00203 at weight 1.0. No limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged: the arrival marker sits 5 seconds from the nearest fix (no clock skew under (a)), there is no sampling gap or fix shortfall under (b), the chat holds exactly the 3 messages the trip record records under (c), and the $4.00 fee reconciles exactly with the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee under the POL-NS-01 resolution rule, so limb (d) is satisfied. EV-CHAT-00203 carries the pre-pass tag IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, but that is a schema-level assessment which meets no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08; under POL-GEN-02 it can only temper confidence in a finding that rests on it, and no finding here does.

The POL-NS-09 escalation triggers do not fire either. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb (d) reads; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) is not met; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check cannot trip, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d being 2 against a threshold of 4. This is a case for a monetary full refund of the $4.00, not for a hold.

claims.text: The driver reached the pickup pin, so the arrival limb of the no-show test is satisfied: the trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — the radius fee_schedule fixes for this zone class — on 21 qualifying fixes running from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35, with a closest approach of 18.7 m. That is a genuine arrival at the pin, not a never-arrived trip.

The 19:41:35 arrival marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05: at that instant the driver was inside the arrival radius, part of the continuous in-radius run the trace records from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35, and nowhere near the 300 m line, so the distance limb fails. On speed, the trace carries only two distinct readings, 0.0 kph within the hold and 29.6 kph on the moving approach before the first in-radius fix, so the 15 km/h limb is not met at the marker either. No false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) arises against this driver.

The SGD 4.00 charge is arithmetically correct and there is no fare defect for POL-NS-08(d) to bite on: fee_schedule.resolution_rule takes the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), a tie at SGD 4.00 on the zone-class dimension, and the fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line is SGD 4.00 against a charged total of SGD 4.00.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04: limb (b) fails, because the driver answered the rider's 19:42:50 message with a chat reply at 19:44:31 — 101 seconds later, inside the 120-second window — and POL-NS-04 does not apply at all where the driver replied in time. The chat log is IMPAIRED (weight 0.85, issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY), which I disclose; the impairment concerns the contestable meaning of MSG-00203-002, not the delivery timestamps this claim rests on.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and cannot ground an escalation under POL-NS-09(d): driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 terminations against 131 completed trips in 30 days is 0.015, below 0.08. POL-GEN-01 confines this test to those two fields; the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags (1) is not the trailing-30-day figure POL-NS-07 reads and may not be substituted for it.

No other escalation limb on the parties' histories is met: rider and driver each record disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not triggered, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the three-dispute threshold in POL-NS-09(d). The rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags (2) is a different field, and POL-GEN-01 forbids reading it in place of the trailing-30-day counter.

The trace that carries the arrival and dwell facts is unimpaired and no confidence cap below the platform floor applies: it is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, runs an unbroken 10-second cadence with a maximum gap of 0 seconds, carries 60 fixes on both the driver and rider tracks, and so engages none of POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d). POL-NS-09(e) is therefore not triggered and POL-GEN-02 caps confidence in any finding resting on it at no less than 1.0.

I do not dispute the arithmetic that defeats the fee: on the driver's own unimpaired trace the effective in-geofence dwell is 195 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a 105-second shortfall, and the trip was terminated at 19:44:40, before that minimum elapsed, so POL-NS-01 limbs (c) and (d) are not met and POL-NS-06 directs the fee's refund. The driver's case is not that the waiting period was served; it is that his conduct was a genuine, stationary arrival at the pin rather than a false marker, that he answered the rider inside the reply window, and that nothing on this record warrants an escalation or an adverse referral against him.

ruling.explanation:
Rider, your $4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded in full. Driver, no compensation is payable for this trip.

WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. For a no-show fee to be chargeable, the driver must hold position inside the pickup geofence for the full minimum for the zone class — 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup like Blk 267 Tampines St 21. The clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' marker. On the driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00203, COMPLETE, weight 1.0) the driver was inside the 50 m arrival radius on 21 consecutive fixes from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35 — one continuous in-geofence dwell of 195 seconds, 105 seconds short of 300. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00203, COMPLETE, weight 1.0) agrees on its own clock: the arrival marker is 19:41:35 and the trip was cancelled at 19:44:40, 185 seconds later, still short even taking the platform's own event times at face value. POL-NS-01(c) is therefore not met, the fee is not chargeable, and POL-NS-06 directs a full refund of the $4.00 itemised in the fare breakdown.

NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not, and POL-NS-06 states that where the dwell falls short 'the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable'. The $3.20 figure carried in the fare breakdown's derived money block is therefore not earned on a 195-second hold, and driver_compensation_sgd is null.

THE POINTS THE PARTIES RAISED.
- Arrival was genuine, not a false marker. At 19:41:35 the driver was inside the arrival radius and stationary, so the distance and speed limbs of POL-NS-05 are not met and no false-arrival entry is recorded under POL-NS-05(ii). This is accepted, and it does not save the fee: the defect is in dwell duration, not in arrival.
- POL-NS-04 does not apply. The driver replied to the rider's 19:42:50 message at 19:44:31, 101 seconds later and inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) fails and the rider is not exonerated under that clause. Accepted — but POL-NS-06 refunds on the shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present or responded, so this changes nothing.
- Rider presence. The rider's device stayed within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius throughout (farthest fix 51.6 m, mean 42.8 m). Accepted as fact, though again the refund does not turn on it.
- No accumulation under POL-NS-06(i). The trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to add, and the only traffic advisory on file (EV-ADVIS-00203-01) is MISSING at weight 0.0 — an absent artifact that can carry no fact. Limb (i) is unavailable and cannot reduce the 300-second minimum.
- No escalation. Confidence in this ruling is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor. No POL-NS-09 limb fires: the driver's anti-farming figures are clear (no_show_terminations_30d = 2 against a threshold of 4, and 2/131 = 0.015 against 0.08), disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 for both parties, and rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below 3. The lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags (rider 2, driver 1) are context-only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used in either direction.
- Evidence weight. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-00203 and EV-TRIP-00203, both COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so nothing caps the outcome below a full refund. EV-CHAT-00203 carries a pre-pass tag, IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 for LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, but it meets no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 and no finding here rests on how 'wait ah, i coming liao' is read; the send, delivery, read and cancellation timestamps used are unambiguous.

REFERRALS. None. No clause produces one on this record: the arrival marker was true, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not apply; the billing is not at issue; and the anti-farming escalation does not trip.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the $4.00 cancellation (no-show) fee charged on TRP-00203 is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

Why the charge cannot stand. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions in POL-NS-01 hold. Limbs (a) and (b) do: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:41:35, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00203) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius the fee schedule fixes for this zone class on 21 qualifying fixes running from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35, closest approach 18.7 m. Limb (c) does not hold. The required continuous in-geofence dwell for STANDARD is 300 seconds; the effective dwell on the driver's own trace is 195 seconds — 105 seconds short (POL-NS-01(c), POL-NS-06). Limb (d) fails with it, because the trip was terminated by the driver at 19:44:40, before the required wait had run. The trip record standing alone says the same thing: arrived 19:41:35, cancelled 19:44:40, an elapsed 185 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 a dwell shorter than the zone minimum makes the fee not chargeable and refunds it in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not anyone answered messages.
